svg.aria-label: Timeline of one race: Binance move at 0 ms, top taker order at −49 ms, our order at +34.5 ms
svg.text: One race on one clock: t = 0 is when Binance's top level empties (the price moves)
Dots are medians; whiskers and pale bars span the middle half (25th–75th percentile). Top taker: 2,743 of its orders that reached Predict before a move that came within 300 ms.
Us: the REPRICE-8 replay (decision = trigger + 3.5 ms, 22 ms assumed path). Predict makers: when the stale quotes REPRICE aimed at were pulled. Four already-used days.
